newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA M1 DOWN 2.40 PCT, M2 FALLS 0.63 PCT IN WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA M1 DOWN 2.40 PCT, M2 FALLS 0.63 PCT IN WEEK.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply fell to 142.1 billion levs on August 30 from 145.6 billion levs on August 23 and M2 eased to 786.2 billion levs from 791.2 billion levs, preliminary central bank figures showed.

Total broad money fell 0.24 percent to 816.9 billion levs as lev-denominated broad money retreated 0.35 percent to 482.0 billion levs and dollar-denominated broad money edged down 0.09 percent to 334.9 billion levs.
Hard currency-denominated term deposits of companies and individuals totalled $ 1.540 billion on August 30, down $52 million from the week before.
Lev-denominated term deposits of companies and individuals were unchanged at 279 billion levs. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
